card.line: Mahaneh-dan, meaning camp of Dan, was a place between Zorah and Eshtaol where the Spirit first stirred Samson and where Danites later camped.

moments.title: The Spirit stirs Samson
moments.text: As Samson grew, the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.

moments.title: Danites camp and name the place
moments.text: Six hundred armed Danites set out from Zorah and Eshtaol and camped near Kiriath-jearim in Judah. That is why the place west of it is called Mahaneh-dan to this day.
